about.title: About SchengenVisaChecklist.com
about.description: SchengenVisaChecklist.com helps travellers prepare clearer visa document packs by turning route details into structured, source-aware checklists.
about.intro: Visa requirements can feel scattered across embassy pages, appointment providers, PDFs, and local instructions. Our goal is to make preparation easier by organizing the most important steps, documents, timing notes, and official links in one readable place.

sections.title: What we do
sections.body: We help applicants understand what they may need before a Schengen visa appointment: identity documents, residence evidence, travel plans, insurance, financial proof, employment or sponsor documents, biometrics notes, fees, timelines, and official source links.

sections.title: How our checklists are created
sections.body: Each checklist starts with the route you select, such as nationality, country of residence, destination country, and visa type. The result is built from editor-managed rules, official sources, and clearly labelled guidance so the document pack is easier to review before submission.

sections.title: Why official sources still matter
sections.body: Schengen requirements can change without much notice, and appointment providers may apply country-specific or location-specific instructions. Always check the linked embassy, consulate, government, VFS, TLS, or BLS page before booking, paying, or submitting documents.

sections.title: What we are not
sections.body: We are not an embassy, consulate, VFS, TLS, BLS, visa application centre, immigration adviser, lawyer, or government website. We do not issue visas, book appointments, guarantee approval, or replace official instructions.

principles: Keep guidance practical and easy to scan.
Separate required, conditional, and optional documents.
Encourage travellers to verify final details with official sources.
Avoid approval guarantees or misleading official language.
about.closing: Use this site as a preparation aid, then verify the final requirements with the official source for your destination and appointment location.
